item.title: Unpaid DHS workers ‘distracted’ as terror threats rise, fueling airport security concerns
item.summary: Chad Wolf warns unpaid DHS workers are "distracted" amid rising terror threats, as the government shutdown strains TSA operations at major airports.

item.title: Miranda Lambert's childhood home hits market for $1.59M as parents say goodbye to Texas farmhouse
item.summary: Miranda Lambert's childhood home in Lindale, Texas, hits the market for $1.59 million. The country star lived here from age 14-21 during her formative years.

item.title: Former FBI agent Robert Levinson’s disappearance still unsolved as bureau presses for new tips
item.summary: FBI renews appeal for missing former agent Robert Levinson who disappeared in Iran nearly 20 years ago. A $5 million reward is being offered for information.

item.title: Ethan Hawke’s advice on unrequited love goes viral, resonates with millions
item.summary: Ethan Hawke's unrequited love advice from the Academy Awards red carpet has gone viral, with fans calling it "insanely beautiful" after his "Blue Moon" Best Actor nomination.

item.title: Alabama student’s death leads ex-detective to reveal how investigators probe possible drugging cases
item.summary: Authorities have not ruled out drugging after University of Alabama student Jimmy Gracey was found dead in Barcelona's waters near Port Olímpic area.

item.title: GLP-1 drugs and low-carb diets leave Americans short on fiber as protein craze grows, experts warn
item.summary: Protein products are flooding grocery shelves as influencers promote high-protein diets, but nutrition experts caution the anti-carb trend oversimplifies eating.

item.title: Maddow rebukes Robert Mueller’s legacy as 'wildly outmaneuvered' following his death at 81
item.summary: Rachel Maddow said Robert Mueller was "wildly outmaneuvered" by Bill Barr after his death at 81 on Saturday, and said that weighed heaviest on his legacy.

item.title: Texas parents flood school choice program, far exceeding the initial 90,000 student capacity
item.summary: Texas school choice applications for the Texas Education Freedom Accounts surpassed 241,000, far exceeding the 90,000 spots funded by the program's initial $1 billion investment.

item.title: Chicago residents unionize to fight possible displacement, rent hikes over Obama Presidential Center
item.summary: Woodlawn tenants at Chaney Braggs Apartments have formed a union to fight displacement they say is driven by the Obama Presidential Center's arrival.

item.title: Trump says ICE will deploy to airports Monday to assist TSA amid funding standoff
item.summary: President Donald Trump will deploy ICE agents to airports across the country on Monday in support of TSA agents amid a funding battle with Democrats.
